fullContentHtml:
📢 ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer 'SC' CBT Exam Date Announced

Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO ICRB) has officially scheduled the Computer Based Test (CBT) for recruitment to the posts of Scientist / Engineer 'SC' (175 Vacancies). The nationwide exam will take place on 19 October 2026. Candidates who completed their online applications can view exam schedule details below.

📅 Key Dates

  • Written CBT Exam Date: 19 October 2026
  • Admit Card Release Date: October 2026 (approx. 10 days before exam)
  • Exam Pattern: Discipline Specific (80 Marks) + Aptitude/Ability Test (20 Marks). Total 100 Marks (120 Minutes).
  • Interview Stage: Shortlisted candidates with minimum qualifying marks in CBT will be invited for personal interview.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q1. What is the exam date for ISRO ICRB Scientist Engineer 2026?

The Computer Based Test (CBT) will be held on 19 October 2026.

Q2. When will ISRO Scientist Engineer admit card be released?

The admit cards will be released in the first week of October 2026 on the official portal.
